provenance.derivedFrom: brick-v1.json: narrow gauge (3 studs = 24 mm rail centres, 6-stud = 47.8 mm sleepers, Mattzobricks narrow/dual gauge geometry pages, TrixBrix narrow range). Every value is the standard profile with the stud column between the centre studs and each rail removed: rails 20 -> 12, outer studs/pins/bays/ribs 28 -> 20 (-8 mm), central bay +/-16 -> +/-8 (columns +/-4 only). Rail section, ties, tie pitch, stud and clutch sizes are unchanged.
provenance.connector: No published dimensions exist for the official narrow-track clip (85976/85977) or TrixBrix's narrow ends. The narrow end is the accepted brick end's central clip and centre pin (|y| <= 15.95 mm, unchanged) with the rail-end tongues removed; narrow rails butt at the port face 0.1 mm inboard, like the accepted body. A narrow end therefore mates any narrow end and any centred dual-gauge end (which keeps the full standard end). It does NOT mate official 85976 or TrixBrix narrow track; physical clip retention without the rail tongues is a trial gate.
